Classification: Bloodline (@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}-created)

@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.qfOm4Ua1XRKsv8bU]{Gargoyles} are hybrids of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} blood, created by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} as an experiment in slavery during the worst nights of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} war, using captured Cainites imbued with hatred for their "ancestors." They turned the tide of that war and have guarded nearly every @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} chantry since the mid-12th century. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} blood grants their hideous demonic appearance, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} blood their bestial nature, and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} blood their chiropteran wings and stone-hardening skin. Most @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.qfOm4Ua1XRKsv8bU]{Gargoyles} have simple needs, little independent ambition, and fierce loyalty to their own kind and their Tremere creators, overseen by the Tremere Volsalve/Virstania who takes a motherly interest in them. Rumor holds that a legendary escaped Gargoyle known as the Rock Lord founded a hidden colony of free @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.qfOm4Ua1XRKsv8bU]{Gargoyles}, inspiring some to dream of liberty. Any Gargoyle found without a Tremere handler is generally destroyed by other clans on sight.

Disciplines: Flight, Fortitude, Potence, and a Special power unique to the bloodline.

Advantage: Gargoyles are built as guardians and protectors, beginning play with two Traits of Brawl.

Disadvantage: Bred to be slaves and servants, Gargoyles have weak wills and suffer a two-Trait penalty resisting Dominate or other mind-control effects.

Organization: Bound to Tremere chantries as guardians, sleeping in piles for comfort, fiercely territorial; a small population of escaped free Gargoyles struggles to reproduce independently.

Suggested Viae: Beast, though a few follow the Road of Heaven.
